smoke.description: Minimal load to prove the scripts, data and environment work. Run before anything else.

average-load.description: Typical peak-hour load. The baseline for SLO verdicts and regression comparison.

stress.description: Above-peak load to see how the system behaves and degrades beyond its expected maximum.

spike.description: Sudden burst far above peak, then back to normal, to check survival and recovery.

soak.description: Sustained load for hours to expose leaks, slow degradation and resource exhaustion.

breakpoint.description: Continuous ramp until the system fails. Finds the ceiling quickly; the abort thresholds end the run.

capacity.description: Stair-step: hold each load level long enough to measure steady state. Input for capacity analysis.
